description: This file contains functions for normalizing document features in a Slate editor, including inline marks, soft breaks, links, relationships, and document structure elements.

methods.name: areArraysEqual
methods.description: Checks if two arrays are equal in length and content.

methods.name: normalizeTextBasedOnInlineMarksAndSoftBreaks
methods.description: Normalizes inline marks and soft breaks in a text node within the editor.

methods.name: normalizeInlineBasedOnLinksAndRelationships
methods.description: Normalizes inline nodes like links and relationships based on configuration.

methods.name: normalizeElementBasedOnDocumentFeatures
methods.description: Normalizes block elements based on document features such as headings, lists, dividers, and layout.

methods.name: withDocumentFeaturesNormalization
methods.description: Enhances an editor with normalization logic based on document features and relationships.
